plain: New motion tokens (springs, stagger, extended duration, enter scales, swap and reveal blur, nudge and slide travel) and hds.motion.springs/stagger/extended/scale; spring easings now compile to valid linear() CSS, so expressive transitions that silently did nothing now animate.

steps.plain: --primitive-easing-elastic is now a linear() spring curve instead of the invalid spring(300, 20, 1), so transitions using it (and --hds-motion-expressive-easing) now animate with a small overshoot; if you set this variable yourself, use a linear() or cubic-bezier() value.
